verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

verses.html: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.text: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.html: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.text: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.html: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.text: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.html: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.text: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
